source.title: OMG Systems Modeling Language (SysML) Version 2.0, Part 1: Language Specification
source.pdf_extraction: pdftotext -layout and pdftohtml -xml; Courier font spans were retained as raw evidence
source.license_note: This inventory records facts and short transcriptions from the OMG specification for conformance work; preserve the specification copyright and license notices when redistributing source excerpts.

current_repository_release_corpus.evidence: The corpus contains VehicleStates-related material but no Exercising, OnOff1..OnOff6, OperationalStates, TurnedOn, or PowerUp examples by exact-name scan.

interpretation.important_distinction: A Courier-font span is evidence that the PDF presents code-like text, not proof that the span is an independently parseable SysML model.
interpretation.candidate_text_code: A span containing a SysML/KerML declaration and syntax delimiters; it is a fixture candidate after column/continuation cleanup.
interpretation.lexical_or_fragment: A keyword, name, multiplicity, operator, diagram label, grammar token, expression, or an incomplete continuation.
interpretation.manual_review: Required for table-column interleaving, page continuations, ellipses, omitted context, external-language bodies, and examples that rely on definitions from earlier text.
interpretation.independent_ast_oracle: The PDF text is a source oracle. It is not an AST golden oracle; expected AST objects must be authored separately and compared field-for-field.

extraction_summary.automatically_parseable_count_reason: The PDF layout interleaves graphical and textual notation and splits examples across pages; independent fixture boundaries and cleanup require human review.

known_examples.code: state def StateDef1;

known_examples.context_note: The table places a transition usage beside two state usages; the combined text is not a complete rootNamespace. Tests parse the three concrete productions with stateUsage and transitionUsage grammar entries.
